title: Career Coach – Training & Operations
description:
PhysicsWallah Institute of Innovation (PW IOI)Hiring: Career Coach – Training & Operations

**Open Positions:**
Associate / Senior Associate and Manager

**Department:**
Career Services

**Location:**
PhysicsWallah Institute of Innovation, Bengaluru (On-site)

About the Role

PhysicsWallah Institute of Innovation is looking for passionate and driven professionals to join its Career Services team. The role involves training and mentoring students to enhance their communication, professional skills, and overall employability, while supporting the execution and operations of Career Excellence initiatives.

We are hiring for two levels within the same department, with responsibilities aligned to the candidate's experience and capabilities.

Position 1: Associate / Senior Associate

**Experience:**
1–3 years

The Associate / Senior Associate will be responsible for conducting student training sessions, supporting career readiness initiatives, coordinating assessments, and maintaining student progress records.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Conduct sessions on communication skills, soft skills, resume building, and interview preparation.
2. Facilitate mock interviews, group discussions, and interactive learning activities.
3. Provide constructive feedback to students and support their professional development.
4. Coordinate student assessments, mock interviews, and group discussions.
5. Prepare assessment materials, schedules, evaluation rubrics, and training documentation.
6. Track student progress, maintain records, and prepare periodic reports.
7. Identify student learning gaps and support the implementation of improvement plans.
8. Assist in the execution of workshops, training schedules, and other Career Excellence initiatives.

Position 2: Manager

**Experience:**
3–8 years

The Manager will take ownership of training and operational delivery within the Career Services function, ensuring effective execution of student development initiatives, assessment processes, and employability improvement programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead the planning and execution of student training programs covering communication, soft skills, resume building, and interview preparation.
2. Design and implement structured training plans, assessment frameworks, and student development initiatives.
3. Oversee mock interviews, group discussions, assessments, and other career readiness activities.
4. Monitor student performance and employability metrics, identify learning gaps, and drive improvement initiatives.
5. Manage training schedules, operational processes, reporting, and coordination with internal stakeholders.
6. Ensure consistency and quality in training delivery, assessments, and student feedback mechanisms.
7. Mentor team members and support their development in training delivery and operational execution.
8. Drive continuous improvement in Career Excellence processes, student engagement, and overall program effectiveness.

Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in English, Education, HR, Business, or a related discipline.
* MBA in HR or a related specialisation will be an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interest in training, mentoring, and student development.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and documentation.
* Strong organisational, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, on-site environment.

Work Location

PhysicsWallah Institute of Innovation

12th Floor, Tower B, Brigade Signature Towers, Old Madras Road, Sannatammanahalli, Hoskote Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka – 560049.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time, on-site.

title: Graduate Engineering Trainee
description:
**Role Description**

The Graduate Engineering Trainee role at Facil is a full-time one year, on-site position based in Bengaluru. The trainee will support manufacturing and mechanical engineering activities related to fasteners and small parts used in automotive and utility vehicles, including assisting in process optimization and quality improvement

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
•

Quality inspection:
Inspect incoming and outgoing parts against drawings, specifications, inspection plans, part identification, quantity,labels, packaging, and documentation.

•
Measurement:
Perform visual and dimensional checks using Vernier calipers, micrometers, thread gauges, and other basic measuringinstruments

.•
Non-conforming material:
Identify, label, segregate, record, and promptly report doubtful or non-conforming material. Final release ordisposition remains with the authorized employee.

•
Technical support:
Read and compare customer drawings, supplier drawings, specifications, dimensions, tolerances, materials, coatings,threads, and mechanical-property requirements under guidance.•
Documentation:

Prepare and maintain inspection reports, comparison sheets, certificates, photographs, samples, and technical records withaccuracy and traceability

.•
Cross-functional support:
Assist Quality, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Warehouse teams with sorting, reinspection, inventorychecks, dispatch verification, and continuous-improvement activities.•
Compliance:
Follow company quality, safety, operational, and housekeeping requirements and perform other trainee-level duties assigned bythe supervisor.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automotive or a related discipline only ( Other streams pls excuse )
* Basic understanding of engineering drawings, limits, fits, tolerances, manufacturing processes, and inspection methods.• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.• Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and present technical information clearly.
* Knowledge of automotive components, fastening technologies, or production processes is an advantage.
* Ability to work in an on-site team environment in Bengaluru, with a proactive, learning-oriented mindset.

**TRAINEE PROGRAM & CAREER OPPORTUNITY**

This is a one-year trainee program providing practical exposure to automotive fasteners, inspection methods, quality systems, engineering drawings, and cross-functional working.

At the end of the program, the trainee may be considered for regular employment based on business requirements, availability of a suitable role, and documented performance. If not absorbed, the trainee will receive a training / experience certificate upon successful completion and will be relieved in line with the applicable engagement terms.

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
description:
**Make Your Mark**
Reporting to the Senior Director of Information Security, the Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst will play a vital frontline role in monitoring, detecting, analyzing, and responding to cyber threats and security incidents across BlackLine. In this role, you will participate in operational shift/on-call coverage, monitor and triage security alert queues, investigate potential security events, execute incident containment procedures, assist with vulnerability management workflows, collaborate with cross-functional engineering and IT teams, and contribute to the continuous enhancement of BlackLine’s enterprise security posture.
  
  
**You'll Get To**

* Participate in a 'follow-the-sun' operational monitoring schedule, acting as a primary responder to actively monitor, triage, and manage the real-time security alerts queue across global environments.
* Bridge the gap between detection and remediation by executing and refining standard operating procedures (SOPs), manual runbooks, and automated playbooks needed to handle threats and eliminate false positives.
* Perform initial triage, scoping, and deep-dive investigation of security events and anomalous activities across endpoint, network, identity, and multi-cloud environments.
* Apply a research-first mindset to threat analysis and incident handling, demonstrating the critical thinking needed to independently investigate alerts, trace attack lifecycles, and evaluate new security tools.
* Operationalize detection and response workflows through scripting and security orchestration (SOAR), leveraging automation to streamline repetitive alert triage and accelerate incident containment.
* Monitor and support the day-to-day operations of key SecOps technologies, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Web Application Firewalls (WAF).
* Leverage AI and LLMs to accelerate security alert analysis, synthesize threat intelligence, automate repetitive triage tasks, and drive operational efficiency across the SOC.
* Flex into evolving security initiatives and technical projects as they arise, taking proactive ownership of tasks that support detection engineering, threat hunting, and operational readiness.
* Support vulnerability management functions by triaging vulnerability scan results, validating exploitability, and coordinating remediation tickets with system and application owners.
* Create and maintain operational shift handoffs, incident summaries, and SOC metrics, translating raw event data into clear insights required for data-driven SecOps improvements.
* Collaborate closely with senior security engineers, infrastructure teams, and IT stakeholders to escalate verified incidents and promote security awareness and best practices across BlackLine.

**What You'll Bring**

* 2+ years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), security monitoring, or incident response role.
* Practical experience with enterprise SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) and EDR solutions (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender), with the technical curiosity to investigate alerts across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills with the ability to correlate disparate log sources, identify malicious activity, and propose effective containment actions.
* Highly disciplined and dependable in fast-paced operational environments, with strong attention to detail and sound judgment during high-priority security incidents.
* Proven ability to leverage scripting languages, such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell, to parse logs, query APIs, and automate routine security analysis tasks.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux/Unix operating systems, including file systems, process execution, and system event logs (Event Viewer, syslog).
* Working knowledge of network security fundamentals, including a solid understanding of the OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, common network protocols, and packet analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark).
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document clear incident timelines, author thorough ticket notes, and communicate technical findings to cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with common cyber attack vectors, MITRE ATT&CK framework, OWASP Top 10, and exploitation techniques to independently triage security findings.

**We’re Even More Excited If You Have**

* Experience triaging security alerts in containerized and Kubernetes environments.
* Hands-on experience leveraging AI/LLM tools for security analysis, alert summarization, or prompt engineering in SOC workflows.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA, GMON), or cloud security associate certifications (AWS, Azure).
* Familiarity with Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) platforms and an outside-the-box mindset for proactively optimizing SOC workflows and hunting threats.

**Thrive At BlackLine Because You Are Joining**

* A technology-based company with a sense of adventure and a vision for the future. Every door at BlackLine is open. Just bring your brains, your problem-solving skills, and be part of a winning team at the world's most trusted name in Finance Automation!
* A culture that is kind, open, and accepting. It's a place where people can embrace what makes them unique, and the mix of cultural backgrounds and varying interests cultivates diverse thought and perspectives.
* A culture where BlackLiner's continued growth and learning is empowered. BlackLine offers a wide variety of professional development seminars and inclusive affinity groups to celebrate and support our diversity.

BlackLine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, age, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, ancestry, color, marital status, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, medical condition, genetic information, or any other protected class or category recognized by applicable equal employment opportunity or other similar laws.
  
  
BlackLine recognizes that the ways we work and the workplace itself has shifted. We innovate in a workplace that optimizes a combination of virtual and in-person interactions to maximize collaboration and nurture our culture. Candidates who live within a reasonable commute to one of our offices will work in the office at least 3 days a week.

title: Lead Analyst, Payment Abuse Operations'
description:

**Job Description**

Team Overview

LinkedIn's Trust Operations team is maturing its Payment Abuse function, and we're looking for a Lead Analyst to help take it to the next level. You will lead complex investigations, raise the standard for how we detect and remediate payment fraud, and turn ad hoc practices into scalable controls, workflows, and monitoring. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, on a global team, with significant cross-functional influence and ownership of outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines deep payments-risk expertise, strong analytical capabilities, and operational leadership to navigate complex business challenges. This individual will lead investigations and strategic initiatives, identify emerging risks and control gaps, influence stakeholders, and serve as a subject matter expert within the Payment Abuse organization.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead complex payment fraud and abuse investigations end to end: find root causes and control gaps, and drive remediation to closure.
* Monitor fraud and chargeback performance against payment network and regulatory threshold, investigate the drivers, and lead remediation when performance trends toward a threshold.
* Use SQL and data analysis to surface emerging fraud trends, define risk metrics and KPIs, and turn findings into operational and product improvements.

* Strengthen operational rigor by standardizing and documenting SOPs, investigation playbooks, and escalation criteria across the team.

* Own initiatives from problem identification through implementation and impact measurement, communicating effectively and operating effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Contribute to operational strategy, regional coverage planning, and the long-term Payment Abuse roadmap.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications

* 5+ years of experience in payment fraud, payment abuse, payments risk, or a related field, including experience leading complex fraud, chargeback, or dispute investigations.
* 3+ years of experience with payment processors, acquirers, card-network rules, fraud-monitoring programs, chargeback programs, or scheme-compliance and remediation initiatives (VAMP, Mastercard, Auspaynet).
* 3+ years of experience designing or enhancing fraud controls, monitoring frameworks, and risk mitigation strategies supporting payment abuse prevention, chargeback management, or scheme-compliance programs.
* 3+ years of hands-on SQL and data-analysis experience, including analyzing large datasets, identifying fraud trends, defining risk metrics or KPIs, and translating findings into operational or product improvements.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience operating in a global, high-volume digital payments environment.
* Experience with alternative payment methods and regional ecosystems, such as SEPA, iDEAL, ACH, and digital wallets.
* Track record of influencing product, policy, or platform changes to reduce abuse risk.
* Experience maturing an existing function by formalizing processes, raising quality standards, or evolving its operating model.
* Experience overseeing work delivered by vendors or managed service providers.
* Experience mentoring analysts in a payments risk, fraud, or Trust & Safety organization.

Payment & Fraud Abuse • Payments Risk • Scheme Compliance & Risk Management • Chargebacks & Disputes • Fraud Investigation • Root-Cause Analysis • SQL & Data Analysis • Control Design • Risk Monitoring & Remediation • Process Optimization • Vendor Oversight • Cross-Functional Leadership • Stakeholder Influence • Mentorship

title: Senior Manager, Security Operations
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
  
  
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
  
  
With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Security Operations Team at Harness is a small, high-leverage organization covering Cloud & Network Security, Detection Engineering (SOC), and Identity & Access Management (IAM). We measure ourselves against NIST CSF 2.0, run a continuous red-team and penetration-testing program with external partners, and work directly with customers on security architecture reviews and briefings. We design for assume-breach: layered preventive controls, strong identity as the perimeter, and fast detection and response.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Manager to own and lead three connected disciplines:
**Cloud Security, IAM, and the Security Operations Center (Detection & Response)**
. You will manage and grow engineers and leads across these areas, set technical direction, and be the accountable owner for how Harness secures its cloud infrastructure, controls access to it, and detects and responds to threats against it.
  
  
This is a player-coach role. You are expected to go deep technically, make architecture calls, and also build the team, the operating cadence, and the metrics that show security maturity improving quarter over quarter.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Cloud Security**

* Own the security architecture and posture of Harness's multi-cloud and Kubernetes-based production environments, including network segmentation, workload isolation, secrets management, and hardened baselines.
* Drive secure-by-default infrastructure through policy-as-code (e.g., OPA), guardrails in CI/CD, and continuous posture management.
* Partner with Platform and SRE on dedicated-tenant and customer-hosted deployment models, including the controls that make those models safe at enterprise scale.
* Support the security of customer-facing runtime components such as the Harness Delegate, including token scoping, least-privilege execution, and containment of compromised components.

**Identity & Access Management**

* Own the workforce and workload identity strategy: SSO, MFA, privileged access, just-in-time access, service-account and machine-identity lifecycle, and access reviews.
* Advance Zero Trust principles across internal systems and production, using a central authority model with human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions.
* Reduce standing privilege and credential sprawl; make least privilege measurable and auditable.

**Security Operations & Detection Engineering**

* Lead the SOC and Detection Engineering function: detection coverage, alert quality, triage, incident response, and on-call readiness.
* Build detections mapped to attacker techniques (MITRE ATT&CK) and validate them through purple-team exercises and red-team findings.
* Own the incident response lifecycle, from runbooks and tabletop exercises to post-incident reviews that feed back into engineering and control improvements.
* Improve automation and tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud-native logging) to reduce mean time to detect and respond.

**Leadership & Program Management**

* Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team; set clear expectations, growth paths, and a healthy on-call culture.
* Translate NIST CSF 2.0 goals into a prioritized roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and executive-ready reporting.
* Work with external red-team and penetration-testing partners to scope exercises, triage findings, and drive remediation to closure.
* Support customer trust: contribute to security briefings, questionnaires, and architecture reviews, and communicate the shared responsibility model clearly and credibly.
* Present security posture, risk, and progress to senior leadership, including the executive team.

**Required**
**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or security operations, with 3+ years managing technical security teams.
* Deep hands-on experience securing AWS, GCP, and/or Azure and Kubernetes environments at scale.
* Strong IAM background: SSO/federation, privileged access management, workload identity, and Zero Trust architecture.
* Proven experience running or building detection and response capabilities, including incident command for significant events.
* Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native detection tooling, and with writing or reviewing detection logic.
* Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance regimes (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to executives and to customer security teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience at a SaaS, DevOps, or developer-tools company, especially one with customer-hosted or hybrid components.
* Experience with policy-as-code (OPA/Rego), infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD security.
* Experience with Enterprise Security.
* Familiarity with securing AI-enabled products and the supply chain around them.
* Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, GCP/AWS security specialty, GIAC) are a plus, not a requirement.

*Harness is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive hiring process.*
**What You Will Have At Harness**

* Experience building a transformative product
* End-to-end ownership of your projects
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefit
* Flexible work schedule
* Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team-building events
* Monthly internet reimbursement

**Harness In The News**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
  
  
At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/
  
  
**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
  
  
Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
  
  
If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Wiz / CNAPP Security Engineering Lead
description:
World leading global engineering consultancy has vacancy in the security division for a CNAPP lead in a global role

Please note you need to have extensive CNAPP and Wiz experience to apply for this role

CNAPP Security Engineer

Wiz platform engineering- Cloud Application Protection Platform

Department: Security Engineering  |  Reports to: Head of Security Engineering

Location Bangalore  |  Employment type Perm

Role purpose

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to own the deployment, engineering and continuous improvement of Wiz across our cloud estate. You will turn cloud risk findings into tested controls, automated workflows and verified fixes, working with Cloud Engineering, DevSecOps, IAM, Security Operations and application teams. The initial technology focus is Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

You will be a senior individual contributor within Security Engineering, responsible for the technical quality, coverage and effectiveness of the Wiz service.

Key responsibilitiesDeploy and maintain CNAPP & Wiz Platforms

·  Implement cloud onboarding across Azure subscriptions and OCI tenancies and compartments. Establish repeatable deployment patterns, validate supported resource coverage and reconcile discovered assets against authoritative cloud inventories.

·  Configure tenant access, projects, resource ownership, SSO and role based access. Maintain least privilege connector permissions and API credentials, monitor connector health and scan freshness, and resolve scanning or integration failures.

Engineer security controls

·  Configure and tune posture, vulnerability and identity controls. Develop custom Cloud Configuration Rules using Rego, Security Graph queries and issue policies, with documented logic, representative test cases and controlled releases.

·  Use the Wiz Security Graph to investigate attack paths and combinations of internet exposure, exploitable vulnerabilities, excessive permissions, secrets and sensitive data. Validate findings against the underlying cloud configuration and business context.

Deliver remediation and prevent recurrence

·  Prioritise exposures using exploitability, asset criticality, external reachability, privilege and data sensitivity. Assign accountable owners, agree remediation deadlines and escalate material risks through the defined governance process.

·  Develop and test fixes with cloud and application owners, including infrastructure as code changes, identity restrictions and network controls. Verify closure through rescanning and source configuration evidence, and address the causes of repeated findings.

Key responsibilities continuedBuild integrations and automation

·  Develop maintainable automation using Python or PowerShell and the Wiz GraphQL API. Automate onboarding, ownership mapping, enrichment, evidence collection and reporting, with secure authentication, logging, error handling and version control.

·  Integrate Wiz findings and relevant events with Microsoft Sentinel and the organisation’s ITSM and DevOps workflows using supported connectors or APIs. Implement deduplication, routing, escalation and status reconciliation so remediation can be tracked through verified closure.

Embed controls in development and cloud platforms

·  Integrate licensed Wiz Code and CLI capabilities into Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines for infrastructure as code, container image, dependency and secrets checks. Coordinate coverage with existing application security scanners and agree proportionate release gates.

·  Translate recurring findings into preventive controls within cloud platforms, reusable deployment templates and developer guidance. Maintain assessment of deployed resources so security visibility also covers resources created outside standard delivery workflows.

Extend workload and data coverage

·  Assess security across virtual machines, containers, Kubernetes and serverless services, including identity, storage, networking and secrets exposure. Identify unsupported services and coverage gaps and agree compensating controls with the relevant teams.

·  Where licensed and supported, implement data security posture management and Wiz Defend capabilities, including required sensors and log sources. Validate deployment impact, data handling and operating responsibilities before extending coverage.

·  Provide cloud asset and attack path context to Security Operations during investigations. Agree escalation and handover procedures and work with existing endpoint, SIEM and cloud native security capabilities.

Provide governance and engineering enablement

·  Produce technical and management reporting on coverage, scan health, critical attack paths, overdue exposure, remediation times, repeat findings and exceptions. Explain the risk and required action in terms appropriate to each audience.

·  Map technical checks to relevant CIS, ISO 27001 and internal control requirements, including ITGC and SOX evidence where applicable. Maintain documented exceptions with accountable owners, expiry dates and compensating controls.

·  Maintain architecture records, operating procedures and a prioritised improvement backlog. Train engineering teams, manage technical escalations with Wiz and evaluate new capabilities against the organisation’s risks and requirements.

Essential experience and skills

·  Demonstrable experience implementing and administering CNAPP platforms in particular Wiz in a production enterprise environment, including cloud connectors, access controls, policy configuration, finding investigation, integrations and remediation workflows.

·  Strong hands on Azure security engineering experience covering Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, networking, storage, compute and cloud logging. Ability to apply these principles across a multi cloud estate.

·  Practical understanding of cloud security posture management, cloud infrastructure entitlement management, vulnerability management and attack path analysis, with examples of reducing material risk.

·  Experience authoring or adapting Wiz custom controls and queries, including Rego or comparable policy as code skills, and validating that controls identify the intended risks.

·  Ability to build and support automation using Python or PowerShell, APIs, JSON and Git. Experience integrating security tooling with ITSM, SIEM or engineering delivery platforms.

·  Experience reading and changing infrastructure as code using Bicep, ARM or Terraform, and integrating security checks into Azure DevOps or a comparable CI/CD platform.

·  Working knowledge of container, Kubernetes and serverless security, including workload identities, exposed services, image vulnerabilities and secrets handling.

·  Ability to investigate findings, propose practical fixes, work through technical disagreements and communicate clearly with engineers, risk owners and leadership.

·  Microsoft Sentinel, KQL and Defender for Cloud integrations; ServiceNow or Jira remediation workflows; enterprise asset inventories and ownership data.

·  Wiz Code, Wiz Defend, data security posture management, sensitive data exposure analysis or security assessment of cloud hosted AI services.

·  Large or regulated cloud estates, control assurance and audit evidence; relevant Wiz training, cloud security certifications or CCSP.

title: Travel & Mobility Manager (Global)
description:
Founded in 2014, Circles is a global technology company reimagining the telco industry with its innovative SaaS platform, empowering telco operators worldwide to effortlessly launch innovative digital brands or refresh existing ones, accelerating their transformation into techcos.
  
  
Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e&), AT&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally.
  
  
Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses:
  
  

* Circles.Life: A wholly-owned digital lifestyle telco brand based in Singapore, Circles.Life is powered by Circles’ SaaS platform and pioneering go-to-market strategies. It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.
* Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide.
* Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year.

Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers.
  
  
**About The Role**
That travel needs an owner. As Travel & Mobility Manager you run travel and mobility for the whole of Circles: every country we operate in, and every country our travellers go to. You sit in Bangalore. Your remit is global.
  
  
One day you are negotiating an airline deal or a hotel programme. The next you are getting a visa over the line, walking Finance through where the travel budget is going, or rerouting a traveller stranded mid-trip.
  
  
Outside Circles, you work through a network of partners: our travel management company (TMC), airlines, hotels, visa agencies and insurers. You choose them, manage them and hold them to their service levels.
  
  
Inside Circles, you do not work alone. Finance is your partner on budgets, spend and savings. People Operations, the People Business Partners and the wider People team are your partners on policy, visas and relocations. Travellers and their managers turn to you as the expert.
  
  
This is not a booking desk. It is a global programme to shape and own, at a company that keeps adding countries.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Run the travel programme**

* Own the TMC partnership: the commercial relationship, service levels, performance reviews and a voice in their roadmap.
* Run the TMC's booking platform so it works for travellers in every country: policy set-up, approval flows, users, integrations and adoption.
* Shape the global travel policy with Finance and People leadership, enforce it, and change it when the business changes.
* Make the programme easy to use, with clear guidance and training for travellers, bookers and approvers.
* Get the travel programme ready for each new location before the first person lands.

**Get us better deals**

* Build preferred hotel programmes in the cities we visit most: tenders, rate negotiation and audits.
* Negotiate airline agreements on our key routes, then hold carriers to what they promised.
* Manage ground transport and every other travel supplier against clear service levels.
* Review suppliers regularly and renegotiate when the value slips.

**Show Us What The Numbers Say**

* Produce monthly reporting that People and Finance leaders actually read: spend, booking behaviour, policy compliance and supplier performance.
* Track travel spend against budget and flag problems early.
* Turn travel data into insight and clear recommendations.
* Find the savings, lead the cost-efficiency initiatives and prove what they delivered.

**Work hand in hand with Finance and People**

* Partner with Finance on travel budgets and forecasts, expense rules, supplier payments and reconciliation, so travel spend is planned and never a surprise.
* Agree savings targets with Finance, then report progress against them.
* Work with People Operations and the People Business Partners on visas, work permits, relocations and policy exceptions.
* Keep Finance and People leaders ahead of the news: what is changing in travel, what it will cost and what you recommend.

**Get travellers across borders**

* Own visas for our travellers end to end. Manage the visa agencies and immigration counsel so applications are filed on time and fully compliant. You direct the work rather than process the paperwork yourself.
* Know the visa and work permit routes for our key corridors: Singapore (Employment Pass, S Pass), the UAE (work, Golden and mission visas), Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Morocco, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Japan and the US (H-1B, L-1, B-1/B-2, ESTA).
* Advise travellers and managers on documents, eligibility and realistic lead times before a trip is booked, not after.
* Keep one central tracker of visas and work permits across every Circles entity, so renewals never slip and nobody gets stuck at a border.

**Keep travellers safe**

* Own traveller safety: assess the risk, know where our travellers are, and lead the response when things go wrong.
* Brief travellers before they head to higher-risk destinations.
* Manage travel insurance, from renewals and the insurer relationship to supporting claims.

**Be the person travellers trust**

* Take on the complex bookings: multi-country itineraries, group travel and executive trips.
* Be the escalation point when a trip goes sideways: a cancelled flight, an emergency reroute, a supplier that has let someone down. Fix it fast, then fix the cause.
* Ask travellers how their trips went, and act on what they tell you.

**Support relocations**

* Support relocation cases in partnership with People Operations, including work permits.
* Coordinate our relocation vendors (movers, temporary housing, destination services) and work with the People Business Partners on packages and allowances.

**What You Bring**

* You have run corporate travel as a travel manager in a multinational, across multiple countries.
* You have worked with TMCs and managed booking platforms such as TravelPerk, Navan or Egencia, alongside travel expense tools. The platform experience is non-negotiable.
* You have built hotel programmes and negotiated with airlines.
* You have a track record of managing travel and visa vendors against clear service levels.
* You have partnered closely with Finance on travel budgets, reporting and savings.
* You can turn travel data into insight and management information that leaders use.
* You have driven cost-efficiency initiatives and can show the results.
* You know visa and work authorisation frameworks first hand across the UAE and wider Middle East, India, the US and Asia.
* You have supported relocation cases alongside a People or HR team.
* Ideally, you have worked in a fast-moving, multi-entity company spanning APAC, the Middle East, Europe and North America.

**How You Work**

* You build strong working relationships across functions, especially with Finance and People colleagues.
* You communicate clearly and with empathy in written and spoken English, and can explain a complex visa process to anyone, from a new hire to an executive.
* You are service focused and you care about the traveller experience, especially when a trip goes wrong.
* You are comfortable working across cultures and time zones, because your travellers can be anywhere.
* You negotiate commercially and balance cost against what travellers need.
* You stay calm and decisive under pressure.
* You are organised and precise, particularly on immigration compliance and deadlines.
* You treat passports, visa documents and personal data with strict confidentiality.

title: Operations Associate – Warehouse (3Yrs +)
description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented
**Operations Associate – Warehouse**
to manage day-to-day warehouse activities, ensuring seamless inventory management, order fulfilment, and dispatch operations. The role will be responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy, coordinating with logistics partners, monitoring stock movement, and ensuring adherence to defined warehouse processes and operational standards.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in warehouse operations, inventory management, and logistics coordination, preferably within the retail, fashion, or e-commerce industry.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Warehouse Operations:**
  Manage daily inbound and outbound operations, ensuring efficient receipt, storage, movement, picking, packing, and dispatch of inventory.
* **Inventory Management:**
  Maintain accurate stock records, monitor inventory levels, and conduct regular stock counts and reconciliations to minimize discrepancies.
* **Order Fulfillment:**
  Coordinate the processing, picking, packing, and timely dispatch of customer orders and inter-warehouse stock transfers.
* **Logistics Coordination:**
  Liaise with logistics partners and transport vendors to ensure timely shipment pickups, deliveries, and movement of goods.
* **Stock Monitoring:**
  Track inventory movement, identify stock shortages or excess inventory, and highlight replenishment requirements to relevant stakeholders.
* **Quality & Documentation:**
  Ensure incoming goods are inspected, properly recorded, labelled, and stored in accordance with defined processes.
* **MIS & Reporting:**
  Prepare and maintain daily warehouse reports, inventory statements, dispatch trackers, and other operational MIS.
* **Issue Resolution:**
  Identify and resolve inventory mismatches, order discrepancies, shipment delays, and other warehouse-related operational challenges.
* **Process Compliance:**
  Ensure adherence to warehouse SOPs, safety guidelines, inventory control procedures, and operational standards.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Work closely with Planning, Procurement, Customer Service, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure smooth warehouse operations.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Supply Chain Management, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Over 3 years of relevant experience in warehouse operations, inventory management, or logistics.
* Hands-on experience in inbound/outbound operations, stock reconciliation, and order fulfilment.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and inventory management or warehouse management systems (WMS).
* Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communication and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in retail, fashion, lifestyle, e-commerce, FMCG, or 3PL environments.
* Understanding of inventory control, cycle counts, stock audits, and warehouse processes.
* Familiarity with ERP platforms and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
* Exposure to high-volume order processing and multi-location inventory management.

**Key Skills**

* Warehouse & Distribution Operations
* Inventory & Stock Management
* Inbound & Outbound Operations
* Order Processing & Fulfillment
* Stock Audits & Reconciliation
* Logistics & Vendor Coordination
* MIS & Excel Reporting
* ERP / WMS Systems
* Process Compliance & SOP Management
* Problem Solving & Attention to Detail
* Cross-functional Stakeholder Management

title: Applied Scientist
description:
**About The Team**
The Housing Trends Metrics and Forecasting team builds and maintains the data pipelines, metric definitions, and analytical methods behind Zillow’s housing market reporting, internal business metrics, forecasting, and market intelligence products.
  
  
The team works across listing, transaction, and property-attribute data to produce recurring housing metrics that provide timely insight into real estate market trends and inform business forecasting, financial analysis, economic research, and sales and marketing operations.
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
Zillow is looking for an Applied Scientist to join Housing Trends Metrics and Forecasting.
  
  
In this role, you will own scoped, high-impact work that improves the reliability, quality, and maintainability of Zillow’s published housing metrics. You will support recurring metric publication, investigate metric anomalies and possible data outages, strengthen data quality checks, and partner closely with engineers on pipeline migrations and system improvements.
  
  
This role is well suited for someone who is comfortable moving between analytical investigation and production data work. You should be able to use SQL, Python, and Spark to debug issues, validate upstream changes, improve metric logic, and build durable solutions for live metric systems.
  
  
You should also be able to take ambiguous measurement or data quality problems, break them into manageable pieces, and clearly explain both the technical trade-offs and business impact of your recommendations.
  
  
You Will Get To
  
  

* Support recurring publication of housing metrics by monitoring outputs, validating changes, and resolving issues before they affect downstream consumers.
* Investigate metric anomalies, suspected bugs, and possible data outages by tracing issues across source data, transformation logic, and publication workflows.
* Design and implement stronger data quality checks, validation workflows, and monitoring patterns for production metric pipelines.
* Partner with engineers to migrate pipelines, reduce fragile upstream dependencies, and improve system reliability and maintainability.
* Evaluate the impact of upstream schema, logic, or source-data changes against historical baselines and communicate revisions, caveats, and trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Improve metric definitions, documentation, and operational workflows so recurring processes are more reproducible, explainable, and resilient.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* You can independently own a well-scoped problem and drive it from investigation through validated recommendation or implementation.
* You know how to translate a business or measurement question into a data plan, implement the analysis, test the output, and clearly explain the result.
* You are comfortable working with large operational datasets and with the engineering realities of production metrics, including schema changes, backfills, data latency, historical reproducibility, and release validation.
* You care about methodological rigor, but you also know how to deliver practical improvements to a live system.
* You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and work effectively in close partnership with engineers.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master’s degree with 3+ years of experience, or PhD with 1+ years of experience, in statistics, economics, data science, computer science, mathematics, engineering, operations research, or a related quantitative field.
* Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, aggregations, and debugging metric logic over large relational datasets.
* Strong Python skills for analytical development, validation tooling, and reproducible workflows; experience with PySpark or Spark for distributed data processing.
* Experience working in Databricks or a similar large-scale data platform, including warehouse-style tables, scheduled jobs, and production data workflows.
* Experience investigating data quality issues, metric anomalies, or production data bugs and turning findings into durable fixes.
* Experience writing maintainable code in a shared codebase using version control, code review, and testing or validation frameworks.
* Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, data caveats, and metric impacts to both technical and non-technical partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building or improving automated data quality checks, validation frameworks, or monitoring for production data pipelines.
* Experience managing noisy operational data and complex upstream dependencies.
* Experience validating backfills, historical revisions, or upstream logic changes against established baselines.
* Experience designing and improving analytical datasets or metrics end to end, from source understanding through transformation, validation, and stakeholder communication.
* Past experience partnering closely with data or software engineers on pipeline migrations or system improvements.
* Interest in housing market data, operational metrics, or applied measurement problems in production systems.

Get to know us
  
  
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
  
  
As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
  
  
Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
  
  
*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

title: Sr. PLC/SCADA Development Engineer
description:
**About the job**

**Job Description: PLC/SCADA Development Engineer**

**Experience:**
 5–10 years

**Qualification:**
 Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Automation Engineering

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced PLC/SCADA Development Engineer with hands-on expertise in designing, developing, and commissioning automation systems for large-scale industrial process applications. The candidate must have practical development experience with both Siemens, Schneider and Rockwell Automation (Allen-Bradley) PLC and SCADA/HMI platforms.

**Mandatory Requirements and Responsibilities**

* Must have hands-on experience on 
  **Siemens, Schneider and Rockwell Automation (Allen-Bradley) PLC programming and SCADA/HMI development**
  .
* Must have experience working on large-scale process automation systems, involving multiple PLCs, distributed I/O, and centralized SCADA systems.
* Must be capable of independently designing, developing, testing, and troubleshooting PLC programs for process control, equipment sequencing, interlocks, permissives, alarms, and control loops.
* Must have experience developing SCADA applications and HMI screens, including process mimic diagrams, equipment graphics, faceplates, alarm displays, and historical trends.
* Must have practical experience with 
  **Siemens TIA Portal/STEP 7, SIMATIC S7 PLCs, and WinCC**
  , and 
  **Rockwell Studio 5000, ControlLogix/CompactLogix PLCs, and FactoryTalk View**
  , as applicable.
* Must understand process requirements and be able to translate P&IDs, process descriptions, and control narratives into PLC logic and SCADA/HMI applications.
* Must have a basic working knowledge of process field instrumentation, including flow, pressure, temperature, and level transmitters, control valves, actuators, and analog/digital signals.
* Must understand PLC–SCADA communication, remote I/O, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and OPC UA.

title: Network Security Operations Specialist (Firewall, F5 & Proxy) -Bangalore VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Network Security Operations professional to join the VNO-ESOC team supporting Heritage 3 Network Operations. This role is focused on delivering reliable, secure and efficient operational support across enterprise network security infrastructure, including firewalls, proxy platforms, load balancers, VMware environments and Cisco FMC. The successful candidate will play a key role in incident resolution, service restoration, change implementation, risk management and continuous service improvement while ensuring high availability of customer-facing security services.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Incident, Problem and Service Request Management
  
  

* Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across firewall, proxy, load balancer, virtualisation and security management platforms within agreed service levels
* Investigate complex service-impacting issues across Cisco, F5, Clavister, Fortinet, NetGuard Firewalls, Symantec/Broadcom Blue Coat Proxy, VMware Hypervisors and Cisco FMC
* Manage L2 and L3 operational escalations including traffic flow analysis, routing issues, NAT issues, VPN connectivity problems, proxy access failures, load balancing issues and performance degradation
* Maintain accurate incident records, root cause analysis, resolution details and closure documentation in line with ITIL practices
* Collaborate with customers, vendors, internal teams and third-party providers to ensure timely resolution of critical incidents
* Identify recurring issues and drive corrective actions to improve service stability and operational efficiency
* Support hardware replacements, vendor escalations, RMA activities and service restoration efforts
* Create and maintain operational documentation, standard operating procedures and implementation guides

Change and Operational Support
  
  

* Review and validate change requests for technical accuracy, risk assessment, rollback planning and customer impact
* Support platform upgrades, firmware updates, patch deployments, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation and lifecycle management activities
* Ensure operational resilience and availability of critical application and security services

Firewall Operations and Security Policy Management
  
  

* Support day-to-day firewall operations across Fortinet, Cisco, Clavister and NetGuard platforms
* Implement and validate firewall rule changes, access policies, NAT configurations, VPN configurations, routing updates and security zoning requirements
* Participate in policy optimisation, governance and operational best practices

F5 Load Balancer Operations
  
  

* Manage F5 load balancer services including virtual servers, pools, nodes, monitors, SSL profiles, iRules and traffic policies
* Troubleshoot application availability, persistence, SSL offloading, health monitoring, traffic routing and performance issues

Proxy and Web Security Operations
  
  

* Support enterprise proxy technologies including Symantec/Broadcom Proxy and Blue Coat platforms
* Resolve URL filtering issues, authentication failures, SSL inspection concerns, policy mismatches and web traffic routing problems
* Implement approved proxy policy changes, access controls, category exceptions and allow/block list updates

**Who You Are**
Essential Experience & Knowledge
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in network security operations, managed security services, telecom operations, hosting environments or enterprise infrastructure support
* Experience leading teams or managing people within operational environments
* Hands-on experience with Fortinet, Cisco, F5, Clavister and NetGuard technologies
* Strong expertise in Cisco FMC including policy management, event analysis, device administration and configuration deployment
* Practical experience with F5 Load Balancers covering virtual servers, pools, nodes, monitors, SSL profiles and traffic management
* Working knowledge of Symantec/Broadcom Proxy and Blue Coat technologies
* Understanding of VMware Hypervisors and virtualised infrastructure environments
* Strong knowledge of routing, switching, DNS, VPNs, NAT, access control, certificates, SSL, TCP/IP and high-availability architectures
* Good understanding of ITIL-based incident, problem, change and request management processes
* Experience managing customer-impacting incidents and complex operational changes
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders

Desired Experience
  
  

* Experience in large-scale multi-vendor network security environments
* Exposure to SIEM integrations, security monitoring, syslog analysis and event correlation
* Exposure to automation, scripting, reporting and operational dashboarding
* Experience working within 24x7 managed services or global delivery organisations
* Familiarity with audit requirements, compliance controls, firewall governance and rule review processes
* Exposure to cloud security, SASE, Secure Web Gateway, ZTNA and hybrid infrastructure environments

**Essential Qualifications**

* Degree or diploma in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Electronics, Telecommunications or equivalent practical experience
* Strong technical knowledge of enterprise network security and infrastructure operations
* ITIL Foundation certification or demonstrated ITIL process knowledge

Desired Certifications
  
  

* Fortinet certifications including NSE, FCNSA or FCNSP
* Cisco certifications such as CCNA Security, CCNP Security or equivalent
* F5 certifications including F5 CA or F5 CTS
* Broadcom/Symantec Proxy or Blue Coat certifications
* Security certifications from Cisco, Clavister, NetGuard or equivalent vendors

Behavioural Competencies
  
  

* Strong customer focus and understanding of business impact
* Clear and effective communication during incidents, escalations and change activities
* Strong ownership and accountability for service outcomes
* Collaborative approach with a willingness to support, coach and share knowledge with colleagues
* Analytical problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities
* Ability to perform effectively during high-pressure operational situations
* Attention to detail in planning, execution, documentation and validation activities
* Enthusiasm for continuous learning and technology development
* Alignment with the Vodafone Way: Speed, Simplicity, Trust, Innovation Hungry, Customer Obsessed, Ambitious and Competitive, One Company Local Root

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of network security technologies and enterprise-scale customer environments
* Exposure to global managed services operations and complex security infrastructure platforms
* Involvement in major incident management, service improvement and lifecycle management initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate with vendors, customers and cross-functional technical teams
* Career growth within a high-availability, security-focused operational environment
* Experience supporting business-critical services across telecom and enterprise infrastructures

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced enterprise firewall administration and security policy management
* F5 application delivery and load balancing technologies
* Enterprise proxy and web security platform management
* Cisco FMC operations and security analytics
* Incident, change and problem management within ITIL-based environments
* Security operations governance, compliance and operational resilience practices

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

title: Senior SAP Basis Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Senior
**SAP BASIS Engineer with 10+ years of hands-on experience in SAP BASIS administration, SAP HANA Database Administration, system upgrades, performance optimization, and SAP infrastructure management.**

**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad (Open for Remote)**

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in administering SAP ABAP and JAVA stacks, managing SAP HANA databases, and supporting complex SAP landscapes. Experience managing SAP workloads on AWS, Linux/SUSE administration, High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), and SUSE cluster configuration is highly desirable.

The candidate will play a key role in SAP landscape management, infrastructure reliability, technical upgrades, production support, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SAP BASIS Administration & Landscape Management**

* Manage end-to-end SAP BASIS administration, implementation, configuration, and operational support across SAP environments.
* Administer SAP ABAP and JAVA application stacks, including installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Support SAP NetWeaver and SAP application landscapes, including:
* SAP S/4HANA
* SAP BW/4HANA
* SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT)
* SAP PI/PO
* SAP Global Trade Services (GTS)
* SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)
* SAP Solution Manager
* Perform SAP system monitoring, health checks, performance tuning, and root-cause analysis.
* Manage SAP system lifecycle activities, including installations, upgrades, patches, and support package implementations.
* Maintain technical documentation, system architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and support documentation.
* Manage SAP transports, system configuration, and connectivity across Development, Quality, and Production environments.

**2. SAP HANA Database Administration**

* Perform SAP HANA database administration, configuration, and ongoing maintenance.
* Monitor and optimize SAP HANA database performance, memory utilization, and resource consumption.
* Manage database backups, recovery, replication, and database monitoring.
* Troubleshoot database performance issues, alerts, and connectivity problems.
* Perform SAP HANA revisions, upgrades, patching, and maintenance activities.
* Manage database availability, security, and operational reliability.
* Work closely with infrastructure and application teams to resolve database-related issues.

**3. SAP Upgrades, Installation & Application Support**

* Execute SAP system installations, upgrades, and technical migrations.
* Perform SAP kernel upgrades, support package upgrades, and SAP Note implementations.
* Handle SAP system refreshes, system copies, client copies, and post-refresh activities.
* Perform SAP application troubleshooting and production support.
* Monitor background jobs, work processes, system logs, short dumps, and application performance.
* Identify technical bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Support planned maintenance activities and ensure minimal downtime during upgrades and system changes.

**4. AWS Infrastructure & SAP Cloud Administration**

* Manage and support SAP workloads hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Configure, monitor, and maintain SAP systems using AWS infrastructure services.
* Support SAP system provisioning, infrastructure monitoring, and resource optimization.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure-related issues affecting SAP application and database performance.
* Collaborate with cloud and infrastructure teams to ensure SAP systems meet availability, scalability, and performance requirements.
* Support SAP infrastructure migrations and cloud modernization initiatives.

**5. Linux / SUSE System Administration**

* Perform Linux system administration, particularly on SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES).
* Manage operating system installation, configuration, patching, and maintenance.
* Monitor CPU, memory, storage, disk utilization, and operating system performance.
* Troubleshoot Linux-related issues impacting SAP applications and HANA databases.
* Manage filesystem configuration, storage allocation, and system-level configurations.
* Work with infrastructure teams to maintain a stable and secure SAP operating environment.

**6. High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR) & Backup Management**

* Design, configure, and maintain High Availability solutions for SAP applications and HANA databases.
* Implement and support Disaster Recovery strategies for SAP landscapes.
* Manage SAP HANA System Replication and database recovery procedures.
* Perform backup and recovery operations to ensure business continuity.
* Participate in disaster recovery drills, failover testing, and recovery validation.
* Monitor system availability and proactively identify infrastructure risks.
* Ensure SAP environments meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives (RTO/RPO).

**7. SUSE Cluster Configuration & Maintenance on AWS**

* Configure, implement, and maintain SUSE High Availability clusters for SAP workloads hosted on AWS.
* Work with SUSE Pacemaker and Corosync clustering technologies.
* Configure cluster resources, monitoring, failover, and fencing mechanisms.
* Support cluster integration with SAP HANA System Replication.
* Troubleshoot cluster failures, resource issues, and failover scenarios.
* Perform cluster maintenance, patching, upgrades, and operational health checks.
* Ensure high availability and resilience of SAP systems running on AWS infrastructure.

**8. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with SAP functional, development, infrastructure, database, and cloud teams.
* Provide technical guidance and support for complex SAP BASIS-related issues.
* Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and infrastructure planning.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive BASIS administration activities.
* Proactively recommend improvements to system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Maintain strong communication with stakeholders and provide regular technical updates.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in SAP BASIS Administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with SAP ABAP and JAVA stack administration.
* Expert-level knowledge of SAP HANA Database Administration.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP NetWeaver landscapes.
* Hands-on experience with SAP installations, upgrades, kernel upgrades, and support packages.
* Experience with SAP system refreshes, system copies, and application support.
* Strong experience in Linux administration, preferably SUSE Linux Enterprise Server.
* Working experience managing SAP systems on AWS.
* Experience with High Availability, Disaster Recovery, and Backup & Recovery.
* Hands-on experience with SUSE cluster setup, configuration, and maintenance in AWS.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP BASIS Certification – System Administration.
* SAP HANA Database Administration Certification.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified SAP on AWS qualification.
* Exposure to SAP BTP Administration.
* Experience with SAP infrastructure automation and monitoring tools.
* Experience with SAP HANA System Replication and SUSE Pacemaker clustering.

title: IT Manager
description:
**Role :**
IT Manager

**Reporting To :**
Chief Operating Officer (COO)

**Location:**
Bengaluru (in-office)

**Department:**
Information Technology

**About Remidio**

Remidio is an innovative, high-growth health-tech company leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to transform global eye care. Our AI-powered ophthalmic solutions enable accessible, early disease detection and clinical decision support, improving patient outcomes worldwide. By combining cutting-edge medical hardware, proprietary AI models, and robust cloud infrastructure, Remidio is bridging the gap between advanced ophthalmology and scalable point-of-care screening.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a proactive, highly capable IT Manager to lead and elevate Remidio’s internal IT operations, enterprise infrastructure, endpoint security, business applications, and IT governance.

As a key partner to business operations and product security, you will ensure our IT infrastructure is secure, resilient, cost-optimized, and fully compliant with global data privacy and medical device security standards. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can balance day-to-day user support with strategic IT governance, enterprise application management, and regulatory readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.**
**IT Operations & Enterprise Infrastructure**

* **Daily Support & SLAs:**
  Oversee internal end-user support (IT ticketing, helpdesk operations, incident response) ensuring high customer satisfaction and strict SLA compliance.
* **Network & Hardware Management:**
  Maintain secure, high-availability corporate networks (firewalls, Wi-Fi, VPNs, switches), servers, NAS storage, and office connectivity.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:**
  Administer corporate cloud service accounts, storage, and billing environments (e.g., Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure).
* **AI & High-Performance Compute Support:**
  Ensure smooth deployment, maintenance, and allocation of high-performance endpoints/workstations utilized by AI/ML and engineering teams.

**2**
.
**Cybersecurity & Endpoint Security**

* **Endpoint Protection & MDM:**
  Administer modern Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR/XDR) platforms and Mobile Device Management (MDM) tools. Enforce strict device enrollment, full-disk encryption, automated patching, application whitelisting, and remote wipe capabilities.
* **Email & Phishing Security:**
  Oversee email security protocols (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), anti-spam/anti-phishing measures, and automated threat monitoring.
* **Incident Management:**
  Serve as the first line of defense for internal IT security incidents, leading investigation, containment, remediation, and root-cause analysis.
* **Security Ownership:**
  Collaborate closely with the Product & Software Security teams to maintain clear boundary definitions between corporate IT infrastructure and product production environments.

**3.**
**Identity Management, M365 & Asset Lifecycle**

* **Identity & Access Management (IAM):**
  Administer Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD), enforcing Least Privilege Access, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign-On (SSO), and conducting quarterly access reviews.
* **User Lifecycle Management:**
  Manage automated, seamless employee onboarding and offboarding workflows (user provisioning, role-based access assignment, immediate access revocation).
* **Asset Management:**
  Oversee the complete lifecycle of corporate IT assets—procurement, hardware inventory tracking, maintenance, recycling, and secure device retrieval during offboarding.
* **SaaS & Software Subscriptions:**
  Audit, track, and optimize software licenses across all business applications to eliminate redundant tools and control costs.

**4**
.
**Information Security, Compliance & Governance**

* **ISO 27001 & Compliance:**
  Maintain internal IT security controls, policies, risk registers, and audit evidence for ISO 27001:2022.
* **Regulatory Alignment:**
  Support cross-functional teams in meeting compliance standards for health tech and data privacy regulations, including HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP Act 2023, and ISO 13485 (where corporate IT touches medical device data flows).
* **Audits & Documentation:**
  Lead internal and third-party IT audit readiness, maintaining up-to-date IT policies, disaster recovery plans, and SOPs.
* **Security Awareness Training:**
  Design and execute mandatory cybersecurity awareness programs, phishing simulations, and data hygiene training for all employees.

**5.**
**Business Applications & Business Continuity**

* **ERP & CRM Administration:**
  Administer and support enterprise business systems, including SAP, Zoho CRM Plus, and integrated SaaS tools (role mapping, workflows, system stability, and vendor escalation).
* **Disaster Recovery (DR) & Backups:**
  Establish, maintain, and regularly test automated backup strategies and Disaster Recovery plans to ensure business continuity across critical data and platforms.

**6**
.
**Vendor, Budget & Project Management**

* **Vendor & Contract Management:**
  Manage relationships with ISPs, hardware suppliers, software vendors, and external IT contractors. Negotiate renewals, contracts, and enforce SLAs.
* **Budget Optimization:**
  Monitor IT expenditures and cloud billing to identify opportunities for consolidation and cost savings.
* **IT Projects:**
  Lead major IT initiatives (e.g., system migrations, network upgrades, security stack implementations) on time and within budget.

**7. Leadership & Team Governance**

* **Mentorship & Growth:**
  Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing IT team (direct reports or external vendors), fostering a service-oriented and security-minded culture.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with HR, Finance, Software Engineering, Quality & Regulatory, and Sales to translate business requirements into efficient IT solutions.

**Core Skills & Qualifications Required**

* **Experience:**
  6–10+ years of experience in IT operations, infrastructure administration, and information security, with at least 2–3 years in a supervisory or management role.
* **Identity & Cloud:**
  Deep experience administering Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Google Workspace, and cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
* **Endpoint & Security Tech:**
  Hands-on mastery of MDM solutions (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Kandji), EDR/XDR platforms, firewalls/VPNs, and email security gateways.
* **Compliance & Governance:**
  Solid working knowledge of ISO 27001:2022 requirements, risk management, and cybersecurity frameworks.
* **Enterprise Applications:**
  Proven experience administering platforms such as SAP and Zoho Suite (Zoho CRM, Desk, People).
* **Communication:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate technical security concepts to non-technical business leaders.

**Preferred**

* **Industry Experience:**
  Prior experience in Health-Tech, MedTech, Biotech, Medical Devices, or Life Sciences environments.

description:
