title: Senior IT & Administration Coordinator (2-3 years experience)
description:
**Company Description**

Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in the USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep, large-scale AI and ML solutions for the construction industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision and deep neural networks, we have built "Kaël", an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, "Observance", uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM models, deviation detection and as-built intelligence.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a proactive Senior IT Administrator to own day-to-day IT operations while building out a more mature infrastructure, identity, endpoint and security backbone as Inkers scales. You will administer Microsoft 365 and endpoint/MDM environments end to end, strengthen identity and access management, support cloud administration across AWS/Azure, and act as the go-to escalation point for complex issues. You will anticipate needs and follow vendors and renewals through to closure, while keeping the workplace infrastructure and services our teams rely on every day running smoothly.

You should be willing to travel to project sites when required, including supporting 3D scanning equipment and on-site IT needs. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru.

**Responsibilities**

* Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive): licensing, mail flow, retention policies and PowerShell-driven automation.
* Manage identity and access across Active Directory, Group Policy and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): user provisioning and deprovisioning, security groups, MFA and Conditional Access.
* Administer endpoint and MDM environments (Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro or equivalent) across Windows, macOS and iOS: enrolment, compliance policies, configuration profiles and app deployment.
* Provide IT support for hardware, software, network, email and systems; set up and configure laptops, desktops, monitors, printers and other equipment.
* Install, configure and troubleshoot Windows and Linux systems.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, switches, routers and other network issues; support enterprise networking (e.g. Cisco Meraki) where applicable.
* Assist with AWS/Azure cloud monitoring, administration and cost/performance optimisation.
* Maintain IT asset records, software licences and equipment inventories; maintain IT documentation, SOPs and troubleshooting records.
* Perform system updates, antivirus/EDR checks, backups and other security activities; support ISO 27001-aligned security and audit practices.
* Support CCTV, NVR, access-control and other office and site IT infrastructure.
* Own employee onboarding and offboarding from the IT side: system setup, access management, ID card and asset handover.
* Track IT issues end-to-end and ensure timely resolution; act as the Level 2/3 escalation point for IT.
* Travel to project sites when required for 3D scanning, scanning equipment setup and on-site IT support.
* Coordinate with vendors for internet, hardware, software and other IT services; compare quotes and keep contracts, renewals and invoices in order.
* Own workplace infrastructure upkeep: schedule preventive maintenance and servicing of air-conditioning, water purification, pantry and beverage equipment, and biometric/attendance devices with the respective vendors.
* Negotiate, obtain and renew Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for IT and workplace equipment; maintain an AMC and warranty tracker with renewal dates.
* Plan and procure office equipment, consumables and everyday workplace essentials so that supplies never run short; review and shortlist service vendors (such as pantry and catering) periodically.
* Arrange employee ID cards and business cards as part of onboarding and role changes.
* Be proactive: keep a preventive-maintenance calendar, raise renewals and replacements ahead of time, and flag issues before they affect the team.

**Qualifications**

* 2-3 years of experience in IT Administration, IT Support or System Administration.
* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, IT or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux systems, computer hardware, networking and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration.
* Working knowledge of AWS/Azure or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with MDM/endpoint management (Intune, Jamf or similar) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to information security practices and frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001) is a plus.
* Experience in vendor coordination, procurement and handling AMCs and renewals for IT and workplace equipment.
* Good communication, coordination and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple requirements.
* Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.

**Language Requirements**

* **Mandatory:**
  fluency in English, Hindi and Kannada (spoken).
* **Added advantage:**
  any additional language (e.g. Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Marathi).

**Key Qualities**

Ownership, proactiveness, strong follow-up, vendor coordination, discretion with confidential information, and a service mindset.

title: Linux platform engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Job Description: Linux Platform Engineer**
**Job Details**

* Job Posting Title: Linux Platform Engineer
* Location: Bengaluru, India
* Job Profile: R3-R4
* Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent
* Experience Level: 12+ years

**Lilly’s Purpose**
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
  
**Come help us unlock the power of the Platform Engineering through AI & Automation**
The Cloud and Connectivity organization is actively looking for a Linux Server Platform, Ansible Subject Matter Expert to join them. Do you like to solve challenges and have an interest in large scale impact? Would you like the ability to impact a global public and private cloud infrastructure engineering through AI and Automation? If so, please apply.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Linux Server Platform SME leads with automation, the design, implementation, and management of enterprise Linux platforms (RHEL, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, SUSE) across on-premises, public cloud, and hybrid environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will serve as the highest-level technical authority for Linux systems, providing architectural guidance, operational excellence, and advanced troubleshooting across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  
  
This role leads the adoption and engineering of Ansible Automation Platform across a hybrid, multi-cloud estate. The ideal candidate brings deep Linux expertise combined with a strong automation-first mindset and proven ability to deliver Linux as a Service through Infrastructure as Code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Ownership & System Administration**

* Serve as the primary SME for enterprise Linux platforms, defining standards, architectures, and best practices.
* Design, build, configure, and maintain Linux server infrastructure.
* Lead OS lifecycle management, including upgrades and end-of-life planning.
* Perform advanced system administration: installation, configuration, tuning, patching, upgrades, performance management, and troubleshooting (kernel, CPU, memory, storage, networking).

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**

* Apply GitOps principles to all automation content (version control, peer review, CI/CD pipelines).
* Enforce idempotency, modularity, and testability standards across all automation code.
* Own the “Linux as a Service” model – defining standard builds, automated delivery, and lifecycle management as code.
* Implement configuration drift detection and remediation as a continuous automated process.
* Implement and maintain Ansible-driven OS patching, provisioning, and configuration drift detection and remediation.
* Develop reusable Ansible content using Ansible Collections and Certified Content.
* Manage AAP organizations, RBAC, credentials, and inventories at enterprise at scale.
* Build and maintain rulebooks to automate incident resolution using Event Driven Ansible.
* Promote and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

**Security & Compliance**

* Harden Linux systems following security benchmarks (CIS, internal policies).
* Manage access controls, sudo policies, SELinux, firewalls, and auditing.
* Partner with Cyber Security teams to remediate vulnerabilities and support audits.
* Assist in incident response and forensic investigations.
* Ensure SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) compliance for Linux environments, including access control, change management, data backup, and security monitoring.

**Monitoring, Reliability & Disaster Recovery**

* Implement and manage system monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions.
* Design and support high-availability, backup, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Participate in root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience with Zerto for disaster recovery and business continuity, including Zerto Virtual Manager and Zerto Cloud Appliance.
* Manage GPFS and Pacemaker clusters for high availability.

**Cloud & Virtualization Support**

* Support Linux workloads on AWS, Azure, GCP, and virtualization platforms such as VMware.
* Create and maintain standardized images, templates, AMIs, and cloud-native configurations.
* Advanced knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services (EC2, S3, VPC, Azure VMs, Azure Blob Storage).

**Collaboration, Leadership & Training**

* Provide technical guidance and escalation support to operations and application teams.
* Review infrastructure designs and changes for Linux platform impact.
* Mentor and train junior engineers, including knowledge transfer sessions and technical workshops.
* Lead infrastructure projects such as server migrations, upgrades, and deployments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and implement new technologies or enhancements.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing updates on platform configuration, projects, and initiatives.

**Documentation & Process Management**

* Create and maintain platform documentation, SOPs, quality documents, runbooks, and disaster recovery plans.
* Ensure compliance with change management and operational processes.
* Oversee change management processes, ensuring minimal impact to production environments.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Manage Red Hat Satellite for patching and system lifecycle management.
* Expertise in Centrify, RedHat IDM and LDAP integration for authentication and authorization.
* Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools.
* Experience working in Agile environments, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Ensure adherence to organizational security policies and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Maintain and troubleshoot OS-related configurations such as security updates, antivirus solutions, and vulnerability remediation.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience managing enterprise-scale Linux Server environments.
* 5+ years hands-on experience with Ansible or Ansible Automation Platform at enterprise scale.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Certifications: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation, Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), Kubernetes/OpenShift certifications preferred.
* Advanced expertise in RHEL, Ubuntu, OpenShift, Kubernetes, Amazon Linux, SUSE Linux Enterprise Server.
* Proficiency in disaster recovery strategies, high-availability configurations (clustering), and cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, hybrid environments).
* Experience with agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) for automation content development
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proven leadership and team management experience.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA)
* Knowledge of ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and experience in ITIL-based processes.
* Experience working in regulated environments (healthcare, finance, pharmaceuticals).

**Additional Information**

* Role located in Bengaluru; relocation required.
* Availability to work flexible hours may be required.

The ideal candidate will have substantial experience with VMWare, Nutanix, DC components like compute, storage, and network, Java/JVM, Docker/Kubernetes, alongside strong coding and scripting skills. Knowledge of networking, AIOps, and workload/data centre migration will be an added advantage.
  
  
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will demonstrate the following characteristics:
  
  

* Proven background in delivering complex, high‑performance, highly available solutions at scale.
* Creativity in coming up with innovative approaches to projects and to any issues that arise.
* A strong bias for action – you are a “do’er” who gets things done.
* Passion for sharing expertise and insight with other engineers and teams.

Currently the tech stack is not 100% fixed, but we have a strong preference for commercial experience of open‑source plus cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have a background that spans development, architecture, and operations. We are looking for full‑stack‑minded engineers with deep expertise in three primary areas and working knowledge across all:
  
  

* Virtualization – AHV, VMware
* DevOps – GitHub, Terraform, Ansible
* Backend / Platform – Python, CLI, RESTful APIs, CI/CD pipelines, process orchestration

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Infrastructure and Virtualization Engineering:**

* Design, build, and operate virtualization environments and remote DC using technologies such as VMware vCenter and Nutanix.
* Support and manage both on‑prem and cloud‑hosted virtualization platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and capacity alignment with business needs.
* Drive data centre and workload migrations using industry‑standard tools and methodologies.
* Manage and optimize data storage, server resources, and other virtual computing platforms.

**Cloud, Automation and DevOps:**

* Engineer and optimize Azure and other public cloud infrastructure (Google / Azure) for scalability, performance, resilience, and cost‑efficiency.
* Design, enhance, and support automation tools and pipelines (GitHub, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD) that drive consistency, repeatability, and team efficiency.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and RESTful APIs for provisioning, configuration management, and operational tasks.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevOps practices to standardize environments and reduce manual work.

**Observability, Operations and Reliability:**

* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions for infrastructure and platforms, leveraging open‑source and commercial tools.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across OS, virtualization, storage, and network layers, with strong problem‑solving and performance‑tuning skills.
* Contribute to the design of resilient, scalable systems and components, including failure‑mode analysis and capacity planning.

**System and Application Management:**

* Oversee the administration, maintenance, and optimization of Linux and Windows operating systems in cloud and virtualized environments.
* Collaborate closely with development and operations teams to integrate applications with underlying infrastructure, optimizing for performance, reliability, and operability.
* Apply software engineering best practices, including version control, code review, and test‑driven approaches, to infrastructure and automation code.

**Collaboration and Leadership:**

* Lead cross‑functional engagements with development, operations, and business teams to drive infrastructure‑related initiatives and modernisation programs.
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to team members, including offshore teams.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of engineering experience at scale, with a strong focus on infrastructure and virtualization.
* Deep knowledge of operating systems (Linux/Windows), virtualization platforms (VMware, Nutanix), data storage, server infrastructure, and networking fundamentals.
* Strong experience with large‑scale virtualization platforms, including VMware vCenter and Nutanix.
* Strong experience in supporting and managing both on‑prem and cloud‑based virtualization platforms.
* Demonstrated experience in data centre migrations and workload/data migration tools.
* Proficiency in scripting and/or coding (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and experience in programming and automation.
* Knowledge of RESTful API design patterns and integration.
* Practical Linux and Windows system administration skills in cloud or virtualized environments.
* Experience working with public (Google / Azure) and private cloud environments.
* Knowledge of programming languages, operating system principles, networking, and software development best practices.
* Experience in designing systems or components on complex projects.
* Experience working with offshore and distributed teams.
* Experience with Test‑Driven Development (TDD) or similar quality‑focused engineering approaches.
* Excellent communication skills, solid work ethic, and a strong desire to write production‑quality code.
* Passionate about learning new tools, languages, philosophies, and workflows.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Certifications in VMWare, Hybrid Cloud, Nutanix, or Kubernetes.
* Experience with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, APM solutions) and alerting/monitoring platforms.
* Hands‑on experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
* Familiarity with AIOps concepts and tooling.
* Knowledge of security best practices, compliance standards, and their application to infrastructure and cloud platforms.

**Why Join Maersk:**

* Opportunity to work with one of the world’s largest integrated logistics companies, leveraging cutting‑edge technologies in a dynamic and innovative environment.
* Collaborative and inclusive company culture that values diversity and teamwork.
* Professional development opportunities and continuous learning initiatives.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

If you are passionate about building and running robust infrastructure platforms, solving complex engineering challenges, and driving automation and reliability across diverse environments at Maersk, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your experience and qualifications to [Email Address].
  
  
We look forward to reviewing your application and welcoming you to our team at Maersk!
  
  
Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. title: Tech Domain Specialist - Modern Workplace
description:

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Tech Domain Specialist – Modern Workplace**
We are seeking an experienced Modern Workplace and End User Computing professional to provide technical leadership across enterprise Endpoint Management services. The role will own and evolve capabilities across Microsoft Intune, SCCM, Windows, endpoint security, automation, application management and Digital Employee Experience, ensuring services remain secure, scalable and aligned with business needs.
  
  
Beyond day-to-day engineering, the role will
**shape technology roadmaps, influence architectural decisions, drive continuous improvement and evaluate emerging capabilities**
across the Modern Workplace ecosystem. A key future focus will be understanding how
**AI, intelligent automation and data-driven insights**
can enhance endpoint operations, employee experience and productivity.
  
  
**Primary Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Modern End User Computing infrastructure, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune and SCCM.
* Experience with Microsoft technologies including Windows 10/11, Active Directory, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Microsoft 365.
* Strong Intune administration & Engineering experience including user management, application packaging and deployment, service administration, PR & Platform scripting, compliance policies, and device profile management.
* Expertise in Intune Conditional Access, Device Compliance, Software Update Management, Endpoint Security, and Device Configuration Policies.
* Ability to coordinate and manage enterprise device provisioning using Intune Autopilot and SCCM.
* Manage global software distribution, Microsoft security updates, and standard desktop software deployments.
* Prioritize and coordinate security patching, software testing, validation, and enterprise-wide deployments and knowledge/experience on third party patching solutions.
* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, operational reports, and executive-level reporting for endpoint compliance, software lifecycle management, device health, inventory, and security posture.
* Strong automation capabilities using PowerShell and VB Scripting for endpoint administration, software deployment, remediation, and operational process automation.
* Work with corporate security teams to identify, assess, and remediate endpoint security risks.
* Meet with internal stakeholders to assess business needs, identify challenges, and define project scope and deliverables.
* Deep understanding & hand on experience with Digital Employee Experience platforms such as Nexthink or SysTrack.
* Strong understanding of endpoint security technologies, security baselines, and modern workplace security patterns.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to influence outcomes, drive adoption, and gain buy-in for new initiatives and ways of working.
* Product-oriented mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrable thought leadership and passion for Modern Workplace, Digital Employee Experience, and Endpoint Management services.
* Strong awareness of IT Service Management principles and ITIL practices.
* Develop and drive the Endpoint Management and Modern Workplace roadmap, aligning technology investments with business objectives, security requirements, and employee experience goals.
* Partner with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Digital Workplace teams to define and implement strategic initiatives that improve endpoint security, automation, operational efficiency, and user productivity.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and Microsoft roadmap capabilities, providing recommendations to leadership on future-state workplace services and platform modernization.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging automation, analytics, and data-driven insights to optimize service performance, compliance, and operational effectiveness.

**Additional/Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) solutions such as BeyondTrust EP & CyberArk, Intune.
* Awareness of Responsible AI, data privacy, security and governance considerations, with the ability to support safe and responsible adoption of AI capabilities.
* Understanding of how AI can complement automation and endpoint telemetry to improve troubleshooting, operational decision-making, knowledge management and service efficiency.
* Understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Firewalls, DMZs, Proxy Services, Secure Network Architectures, and Endpoint Connectivity.
* Experience with REST API integrations, automation orchestration, and system integrations.
* Exposure to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Endpoint Analytics, and security operations reporting.
* Experience integrating Intune, SCCM, Nexthink, Microsoft Defender, and other endpoint management platforms into centralized reporting and monitoring solutions.
* Knowledge of cloud-based endpoint management and modern workplace transformation initiatives.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications such as MCSE, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate, Security Certifications, or equivalent.

**Basic/Primary Qualifications:**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10+ years of experience in End User Computing, Modern Workplace, Endpoint Management, or related technology services.
* 5+ years of experience working with Microsoft Intune, SCCM and enterprise endpoint management technologies.
* Demonstrated experience in automation, scripting and data-driven service improvement.
* Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms and endpoint analytics.
* Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, influence stakeholders and drive technology adoption across complex enterprise environments.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and strategic problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications/Knowledge:**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Strong understanding of ITIL, service management, security and technology governance principles.
* Good understanding of Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, AI-driven automation and emerging workplace technologies.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications such as M365, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator, Identity and Access Management, Azure, Security Certifications, or equivalent.
* Ability to collaborate across matrixed organizations
* Exposure to Endpoint Privilege Management, Remote Support and modern device security capabilities.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-07
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Staff Network Reliability Engineer, Cloud Operations
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
**SUMMARY: HOW YOU WILL IMPACT SKYLO**
As a Staff Network Reliability Engineer, Cloud Operations, in the Global Product Support & Customer Success organization, you are the Cloud Infrastructure domain authority within Skylo’s production NTN network. Everything runs on the infrastructure you keep healthy — RAN NFs, Core NFs, OSS, BSS, and the observability pipeline itself. When a GKE node fails, when ArgoCD drifts, when a Persistent Volume Claim goes unavailable, when a PostgreSQL replica falls behind, when Prometheus WAL corrupts — you own the response.
  
  
You operate across Skylo’s full hybrid cloud estate: GCP public cloud (GKE clusters, Pub/Sub pipelines, Cloud SQL) and on-premise private cloud infrastructure (bare-metal Kubernetes, hyperconverged compute, software-defined storage). You own 24×7 platform health, the observability pipeline (Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), persistent storage operations (PostgreSQL, Redis), and the operational interface with Network Implementation for all GitOps-driven infrastructure changes.
  
  
At Staff NRE level you go beyond keeping the lights on. You define and maintain SLOs tied to network SLA commitments, own error budget tracking, drive toil reduction, and partner with Ops Platform Engineering to automate the infrastructure remediation loop. You are the last technical stop before a Cloud Infrastructure problem becomes an engineering escalation — and you are a force multiplier, mentoring Senior NREs and contributing the operational requirements that shape Skylo’s platform roadmap.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure Operations & Health Ownership**

* Own 24×7 cloud infrastructure health across Skylo’s hybrid production environment: GKE cluster node status, namespace and pod health, Persistent Volume Claim availability, network policies, and multi-cluster federation across Skylo’s GCP footprint.
* Own on-premise Kubernetes cluster health: bare-metal node availability, container runtime stability, CNI networking, persistent storage arrays (Ceph/Rook or equivalent), and hyperconverged compute platform operations (Harvester, KubeVirt, or KVM).
* Monitor and triage infrastructure alarms using OSS dashboards, Grafana/VictoriaMetrics telemetry, GCP Cloud Monitoring, and Loki log correlation — distinguish transient platform events from systemic infrastructure degradation.
* Execute and own Cloud Infra runbooks for P2–P4 fault categories: GKE node recovery, pod eviction and rescheduling, PVC repair, database failover execution, Prometheus WAL corruption recovery, ArgoCD drift remediation, and certificate rotation — without requiring engineering involvement for covered fault classes.
* Own BSS-IIS GKE cluster monitoring and infrastructure health; maintain runbooks that reflect current cluster topology after every infrastructure change.

**Observability Pipeline & Data Platform Operations**

* Own the observability pipeline end-to-end: Prometheus scrape target integrity, VictoriaMetrics retention and query performance, Grafana dashboard coverage and accuracy, OpenTelemetry collector health, and alert routing via Pub/Sub to the OSS.
* Maintain database reliability: PostgreSQL streaming replication health, backup and restore procedures, failover testing, query performance monitoring; Redis cluster operations, eviction policy management, and persistence configuration.
* Ensure log aggregation pipeline health (Loki or ELK): ingestion rates, retention policies, query performance, and completeness — the observability stack must be operational before the network events it monitors can be triaged.
* Partner with NI (Network Implementation & Infrastructure) on all planned infrastructure changes: receive advance notice, validate post-deployment observability, and sign off on operational readiness before the change window closes.

**Cloud Infrastructure Incident Diagnosis & Escalation Authority**

* Serve as the L3 escalation authority for all Cloud Infra incidents: take ownership from the Incident Manager, diagnose at the Kubernetes, storage, network, and database layer using kubectl, GCP console, node logs, and infrastructure telemetry, and deliver a resolution or a decision-grade root cause.
* Lead Cloud Infra troubleshooting bridges: command the technical investigation for GKE node failures, cluster upgrade failures, storage outages, PubSub pipeline disruptions, database failover events, and ArgoCD sync failures — drive to resolution or clear engineering handoff.
* Diagnose and resolve infrastructure failure modes: node NotReady conditions, pod CrashLoopBackOff chains, PVC mount failures, CSI driver errors, network policy misconfigurations, Helm release drift, etcd latency spikes, and cross-cluster federation breaks.
* Participate in the global 24×7 on-call rotation as the Cloud Infra domain escalation tier — reachable within defined SLA windows for Sev 1 events; function as the technical decision-maker, not the first responder.

**SLO Engineering & Reliability**

* Define and maintain SLOs for all Cloud Infra components: GKE control plane availability, database query latency, storage IOPS, message pipeline throughput, and observability stack uptime — tied directly to network SLA commitments to MNO partners.
* Own error budget tracking and the process for trading error budget against deployment velocity; escalate when error budget burn rate requires engineering intervention or deployment freezes.
* Drive toil reduction: identify and eliminate manual Cloud Infra procedures; own the roadmap to automated cluster recovery, rolling restarts, storage repair, and certificate rotation in partnership with Ops Platform Engineering.
* Lead capacity planning for compute, storage, and network resources across public and private cloud — forecast growth based on subscriber projections and new MNO partner onboarding.

**Root Cause Analysis & Post-Incident Ownership**

* Own Cloud Infra RCA end-to-end: lead the investigation, document the complete causal chain from infrastructure trigger through upstream NF impact, and deliver systemic action items with owners, timelines, and measurable success criteria.
* Deliver Initial RCA documentation within defined SLA windows; identify systemic infrastructure failure patterns — cluster upgrade regressions, storage controller bugs, network policy drift, resource exhaustion trends — and translate them into engineering requirements.
* Contribute to the weekly and monthly Network Performance Report: infrastructure availability, database latency trends, storage IOPS, observability pipeline health, and SLA deviation analysis.

**Runbook Authorship & Operational Standards**

* Author, own, and maintain all Cloud Infra runbooks and SOPs: GKE node recovery, database failover, storage expansion, Prometheus WAL repair, ArgoCD rollback, certificate rotation, and cluster upgrade procedures — every procedure tested before production reliance.
* Define the diagnostic decision tree for each known infrastructure fault class: entry condition, triage steps, isolation method, resolution action, and escalation criteria — written at the level where a Senior NRE can execute independently.
* Validate and sign off on operational readiness for all infrastructure changes: DCI/DCE build-outs, GKE cluster expansions, Kubernetes version upgrades, and new on-premise hardware deployments.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Development**

* Partner with OPE as the Cloud Infra domain’s primary automation consumer: define Kubernetes event schemas, alert-to-action contracts, and closed-loop policy requirements for infrastructure auto-remediation.
* Represent Cloud Infra in NI architecture reviews: define observability and operational readiness requirements for all infrastructure expansions and GitOps pipeline changes before go-live.
* Collaborate with Core NRE and RAN NRE on infrastructure-layer issues affecting network functions: pod scheduling, PVC availability, network policy changes, and platform upgrade impacts on NF workloads.
* Partner with security teams on infrastructure hardening: patch compliance, RBAC policies, network segmentation, container image scanning, and runtime security monitoring across public and private cloud.
* Surface toil and automation opportunities to the Service Assurance & Automation team — document the procedure, frequency, and MTTR cost as structured input to the automation backlog.
* Mentor Senior NREs in Cloud Infra domain depth: Kubernetes troubleshooting patterns, storage operations, database reliability, observability pipeline internals, and escalation judgment.

**GitOps, IaC & Platform Engineering Interface**

* Own operational oversight of GitOps tooling in production: ArgoCD sync health, Helm chart version management, drift detection, and rollback execution for multi-cluster deployments.
* Review and validate Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) changes that impact production — ensure operational impact is assessed and observability is in place before merge.
* Engage Skylo’s Platform Engineering and NI teams with full operational context when issues exceed operational resolution authority — deliver a structured problem statement, infrastructure telemetry bundle, and a clear question rather than a vague escalation.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 8–10+ years of infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or cloud operations in a production 24×7 environment — with direct on-call ownership for Kubernetes-at-scale environments.
* Deep Kubernetes expertise: multi-cluster operations (GKE or EKS), node pool management, RBAC, network policies, persistent storage (PVC, CSI drivers), CRD/operator patterns, and production cluster upgrade procedures.
* Hybrid cloud operations: hands-on experience operating both public cloud (GCP or AWS) and on-premise/private cloud infrastructure (bare-metal Kubernetes, KVM, or hyperconverged platforms).
* Production observability stack ownership: Prometheus (federation, remote write, WAL management), Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, and alerting pipeline design with Pub/Sub or equivalent.
* Database reliability: PostgreSQL streaming replication, backup/restore, failover procedures, and performance tuning; Redis cluster operations and persistence management.
* GitOps tooling in production: ArgoCD or Flux CD for multi-cluster operations; Helm chart authorship and version management; Terraform or Ansible for infrastructure provisioning.
* SRE fundamentals: SLO/SLI/SLA definition, error budget management, toil measurement, capacity planning, and on-call rotation design.
* Container and Linux internals: container runtime debugging, kernel-level performance analysis, storage subsystem troubleshooting, and network packet flow understanding.

title: Network Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Network Operations Engineer**

**Job Summary**

Seeking for a skilled and motivated Network Operations Engineer to monitor, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have experience in network monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting, and supporting network devices to ensure high availability, performance, and security.

The Network Operations Engineer will work closely with infrastructure teams, service providers, and other IT stakeholders to resolve network issues, minimize downtime, and maintain compliance with operational standards and service-level agreements (SLAs).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and network links, to ensure optimal performance and availability.
* Perform first-level and second-level troubleshooting of network connectivity, latency, packet loss, and performance-related issues.
* Monitor network alerts and events using network monitoring tools and respond to incidents promptly.
* Troubleshoot LAN, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and routing and switching issues.
* Manage network incidents, service requests, and change requests in accordance with established ITIL processes.
* Escalate complex network issues to senior engineers, network architects, or relevant technology teams.
* Perform routine network health checks and assist with preventive maintenance activities.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), telecom vendors, and third-party service providers to resolve connectivity issues.
* Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations, incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions.
* Participate in incident bridges, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-incident reviews.
* Support network configuration changes, software upgrades, patching, and maintenance activities.
* Ensure compliance with network security policies, operational procedures, and organizational standards.
* Prepare operational reports covering network availability, incidents, performance metrics, and SLA compliance.
* Provide support during planned maintenance windows and participate in a 24/7 rotational shift schedule, if required.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, TCP/IP, subnetting, and IP addressing.
* Hands-on experience with LAN, WAN, VLANs, and network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP.
* Experience with switching technologies, including VLAN configuration, trunking, and Spanning Tree Protocol (STP).
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, or equivalent platforms.
* Basic understanding of firewalls, VPNs, access control lists (ACLs), and network security.
* Knowledge of DNS, DHCP, NAT, and network troubleshooting utilities.
* Experience with ticketing and incident management systems such as ServiceNow or Jira.
* Ability to analyze network alerts, identify potential issues, and implement appropriate corrective actions.

title: Support Engineer (Teleradiology)
description:
**What We’re About**
At Harrison.ai, we’re redefining what’s possible in healthcare. Through our diagnostic AI solutions, we’re building tools that support clinicians to deliver earlier, more accurate diagnoses and raise the standard of care for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
Our mission is bold but simple: to scale global healthcare capacity and create a fairer, healthier world. By using AI as a co-pilot for clinicians, we’re tackling one of healthcare’s biggest challenges, the shortage of human expertise, and giving every patient the chance to access timely, high-quality care, no matter where they live.
  
  
Because while we’re building cutting-edge AI, what we’re really building is hope—that everyone can access the healthcare they deserve.
  
  
***And we’re just getting started.***
**About Your Role**
This Support Engineer (Teleradiology) role is a technical position within Harrison.ai's Service Excellence Squad. The role mainly supports Harrison.ai Services, which provides non-clinical services, including IT support, to Frontier Radiology, an affiliated US teleradiology practice.
  
  
**This role is based in person in Bangalore, India, and works on a rotating shift roster that includes nights and weekends to provide 24/7 support across US hours.**
You will provide non-clinical IT support to Frontier's radiologists, who deliver 24/7 teleradiology reads of critical diagnostic imaging studies across the United States. The focus is on Level 2 end user support with emphasis on rapid resolution of issues that directly impact patient care. This spans hardware (diagnostic workstations), business-as-usual SaaS applications, and specialised clinical systems including PACS, RIS, and Harrison.ai's AI applications and reporting software.
  
  
You will build relationships with radiologists and clinical teams, drive continuous improvement, and advocate for change. Technical downtime in teleradiology directly affects patient diagnosis and care, so you'll need to prioritise urgent clinical support requests and respond rapidly to workstation or application issues. The role also encompasses systems implementation, migration, and consolidation work, with a focus on agile project delivery. You will be solutions-focused, supporting teams across multiple divisions as we scale globally.
  
  
**What You Do**

* Provide Level 2 support to all users regarding workstation setups - including issues with Windows OS, user accounts, and business-as-usual SaaS applications
* Provide 24/7 support to Frontier's US-based radiologists with priority response for reading workstation and clinical application issues that impact clinical workflows
* Perform case management with a focus on SLA adherence for all requests
* Provide support for PACS and RIS systems used in the clinical workflow of teleradiology
* Troubleshoot DICOM and HL7 connectivity, image routing, and PACS/RIS integration issues
* Support and troubleshoot VPN and secure remote access for distributed radiologists
* Support and troubleshoot site-to-site VPN connections for clinical data sharing
* Administer and support SaaS applications such as Atlassian, Office 365, SharePoint, Mimecast, 1Password, Zoom Phone and other applications within the business
* Take remediation actions in response to errors, problems, service requests and incidents, with ability to triage and escalate urgent technical issues affecting clinical workflows
* Perform root cause analysis on recurring issues and implement preventative measures
* Work closely with engineering teams to ensure feedback and faults are fully understood and logged, with resolutions or workarounds being implemented with minimal downtime
* Work closely with counterparts across the global Support Services team on continuous improvement projects, including supporting ongoing education and training
* Maintain HIPAA compliance across all systems and support activities, ensuring strict adherence to healthcare data security standards
* Educate internal customers and radiologists on applications, systems, and best practices

**What You Bring**

* 2+ years of experience with PACS and RIS systems in a healthcare or radiology environment
* 3+ years of previous experience in an IT Support role supporting the Microsoft ecosystem
* Familiarity with both Windows and MacOS operating systems
* Experience supporting healthcare professionals in time-sensitive clinical environments where downtime directly impacts patient care
* Previous experience working in a cloud-first technology environment
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Entra ID, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange Online
* Strong understanding of HIPAA requirements and healthcare data security principles
* Experience with DICOM and HL7 protocols and medical imaging workflows
* Demonstrated ability to triage and prioritise urgent clinical support requests effectively
* Excellent problem and conflict resolution skills with ability to liaise effectively with radiologists and all levels of stakeholders

**Nice To Have Skills And Characteristics**

* Experience with healthcare integration engines (e.g. Mirth Connect, Cloverleaf)
* Experience working concurrently with multiple PACS and RIS vendors
* Ability to handle multiple concurrent tasks/activities and meet high customer expectations
* Tertiary qualified in a relevant IT related field and/or relevant work experience
* Experience with teleradiology operations or distributed healthcare service delivery
* Familiarity with radiology workstation hardware specifications and diagnostic monitor calibration
* Knowledge of cyber security principles and healthcare-specific security frameworks

**Why join us?**
🌍
**Innovate for Global Good.**
Join us to pioneer world-first AI technology that transforms patient outcomes and helps build a healthier, fairer world.
  
  
🤝
**Collaboration Across Continents.**
Work with brilliant minds from every corner of the globe in a culture built on trust, autonomy, and genuine teamwork.
  
  
🚀
**Well-Funded & Global.**
Backed by world-class investors including Aware Super, Blackbird Ventures, Skip Capital, and Horizons Ventures, we’ve raised over US$240M to accelerate our global impact.
  
  
**🌱**
**Scale Your Potential.**
Tap into yearly L&D budgets, mentoring, hackathons, and secondments—all supported by a transparent growth framework to grow your career.
  
  
💻
**Flex for Life.**
Work when and where you do your best—with WFH options, flexible hours, and the autonomy to make an impact your way.
  
  
**🙌 Support for Every Family Journey.**
From fertility to parenthood, loss, and even grandparenthood—we provide inclusive, thoughtful policies to support families in every stage.
  
  
**What's next?**
If you’re inspired by what we're up to, please apply now and we'll be in touch soon.
  
  
*We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity’s not a buzzword here, it’s in our DNA. Diverse perspectives shape our culture and make our work better. We’re committed to building inclusive teams that represent a variety of backgrounds and skills. We look forward to hearing from you.*

title: Technical Consultant-Threat Detection Content & Administration
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Technical Consultant in Threat Detection Content & Administration, you will manage and maintain security technology infrastructure, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, AV, and Cloud security controls. You will develop and deploy use cases, rules, and security policy recommendations to ensure efficient infrastructure functionality.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Develop Use Cases and Rules: Create and tune use cases, rules, and optimization reports to identify malicious activity, and deploy them to the client environment. This involves analyzing system and network activity, indicators of compromise, and attacker tactics.
* Maintain Infrastructure: Ensure that security infrastructures are patched, upgraded, and functioning efficiently, utilizing expertise in Security Incident & Event Management (SIEM), Endpoint Detection and Response technology, and network security technologies.
* Apply Threat Frameworks: Utilize the MITRE ATT&CK framework to classify attacks, identify attack attribution, and assess risk, as well as the NIST Cybersecurity framework to evaluate the risk of threats.
* Deliver Security Policy Recommendations: Provide security policy recommendations to clients based on expertise in security technologies and threat analysis.
* Optimize Security Controls: Continuously monitor and optimize security controls to ensure efficient and effective threat detection and response.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Security Technology Infrastructure: Experience with managing and maintaining security technology infrastructure, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, AV, and Cloud security controls.
* Threat Analysis and Mitigation: Experience with analyzing system and network activity, indicators of compromise, and attacker tactics to identify malicious activity.
* Security Frameworks and Standards: Experience with applying the MITRE ATT&CK framework to classify attacks, identify attack attribution, and assess risk, as well as utilizing the NIST Cybersecurity framework to evaluate the risk of threats.
* Security Technologies Expertise: Experience with Security Incident & Event Management (SIEM), Endpoint Detection and Response technology, anti-malware, anti-spam, and network security technologies.
* Threat Detection and Response: Experience with developing and deploying use cases, rules, and security policy recommendations to ensure efficient infrastructure functionality and effective threat detection and response.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Proficiency in Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security controls and technologies, including deployment and management of cloud-based security solutions.
* Knowledge of Anti-Malware Tools: Exposure to anti-malware and anti-spam technologies, including their integration with SIEM and EDR systems.
* Familiarity with Network Logging: Experience with general user and network activity logging policies, including log collection and analysis.

title: Network Implementation Engineer, Google Enterprise Network
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering or Telecom Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in core networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, ISIS), and LAN switching.
* Experience with MPLS VPN, firewalls, data center networking, and virtual extensible LAN (VXLAN).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Certifications in CCNP, CCIE, JNCIE, or Google's Professional Cloud Network Engineer certification.
* Understanding of Linux/Unix fundamentals, including system resource monitoring and shell scripting.
* Excellent coding skills to develop automation solutions for network monitoring and management.

**About The Job**
As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.
  
  
You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.
  
  
Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and operate Google's network reliably and at scale.
* Execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide.
* Develop creative approaches and collaborate with cross-functional teams to keep operational costs low.
* Monitor the network and repair issues while anticipating needs and escalating issues.
* Own network documentation, update and maintain network designs and plans.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Business Development Executive**

**Coliving | Zolo**

**Own the cluster. Drive occupancy. Run the properties. Deliver the numbers.**

**Compensation:**
₹6.65 LPA (₹3.65 LPA Fixed + ₹3 LPA Performance-Linked Variable)

**Why this role exists**

Zolo's Coliving business operates through properties that need to perform every single day — commercially and operationally.

A property can be clean and well managed, but if beds remain vacant, the business does not perform.

It can achieve strong occupancy, but if resident experience and operations break down, customers leave.

As we scale, we need strong on-ground business owners who can bring
**Sales and Operations together**
and take responsibility for the complete performance of a cluster.

This role exists to ensure that every property in the cluster:

* Maintains strong occupancy
* Converts available demand into bookings
* Creates local sales opportunities
* Delivers a strong resident experience
* Operates with discipline every day
* Resolves customer and operational issues quickly
* Has an accountable and high-performing property team

If the Cluster Business Manager is strong,
**beds get filled, residents stay, teams perform, and properties run well.**

If the Cluster Business Manager is weak,
**vacancies increase, sales opportunities get missed, complaints rise, and execution starts slipping.**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own business performance of the property.
* Drive Sales, bookings, and occupancy
* Convert walk-ins, leads, referrals, and local opportunities
* Identify and create new demand around your properties
* Own day-to-day property Operations
* Deliver strong resident experience and retention
* Lead and manage property-level teams
* Resolve customer and operational escalations
* Track performance numbers and take action when the cluster is behind target

This is not a property coordination role.

**You are the business owner for your cluster — responsible for both filling the properties and running them well.**

**About Zolo and Coliving**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living by bringing together professionally managed homes, essential services, technology, and community into one seamless experience.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveller with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation — delivering experiences customers can rely on while building properties that perform sustainably.

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own Cluster Business Performance**

* Take ownership of business performance of the assigned property
* Track occupancy, bookings, vacancies, move-ins, move-outs, and other key property metrics
* Understand which properties are performing and where intervention is required
* Build clear action plans for properties falling behind target
* Balance Sales performance with strong property Operations and resident experience
* Review numbers regularly and act quickly when performance moves off track

**2. Drive Sales, Conversion & Occupancy**

* Take direct ownership of occupancy across assigned properties
* Handle property walk-ins and convert prospects into bookings
* Follow up actively with interested prospects until closure
* Coordinate closely with Inside Sales teams on leads and conversions
* Understand customer requirements and recommend the right property / offering
* Track available inventory and actively work towards filling vacant beds
* Ensure leads do not get lost because of poor follow-up or property-level execution

**3. Build Local Demand**

* Understand the micro-market around each assigned property
* Identify colleges, offices, institutions, brokers, local businesses, and other potential demand sources
* Build relationships that can generate enquiries and referrals
* Drive resident referrals and other local lead-generation initiatives
* Identify opportunities to improve property visibility in the local market
* Continuously look for new ways to generate demand rather than depending only on centrally generated leads

**4. Own Property Operations**

* Ensure smooth day-to-day Operations across assigned properties
* Maintain property readiness, cleanliness, safety, and service standards
* Ensure rooms and beds are ready for prospective and incoming residents
* Identify operational gaps and drive quick resolution
* Coordinate Housekeeping, Maintenance, Security, and other property services
* Ensure operating issues do not negatively affect Sales, occupancy, or resident experience

**5. Own Resident Experience & Retention**

* Build strong relationships with residents across the cluster
* Handle complaints and escalations with ownership and urgency
* Ensure issues are resolved completely rather than simply forwarded to another team
* Identify recurring complaints and work towards permanent solutions
* Understand reasons for dissatisfaction and potential churn
* Build resident trust through visibility, responsiveness, and consistent follow-through
* Support resident engagement and community initiatives

**6. Lead the Property Team**

* Manage property-level staff across the assigned cluster
* Set clear expectations around Sales, service, discipline, and execution
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure daily activities are completed
* Review individual and property-level performance
* Coach team members where performance needs improvement
* Address underperformance and execution gaps early
* Build a team capable of running properties consistently without constant supervision

**7. Manage Through Numbers**

* Track Sales, occupancy, conversion, vacancy, customer experience, and Operations metrics
* Maintain visibility into performance across all assigned properties
* Understand why targets are being missed rather than only reporting the gap
* Prioritise properties and issues requiring immediate intervention
* Maintain required trackers, systems, and reporting accurately
* Use numbers to decide where time and effort need to be focused

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Strong and stable occupancy across assigned properties
* Consistent achievement of Sales and business targets
* Higher conversion of leads and walk-ins into bookings
* Strong local demand and referral pipeline
* Vacant beds are actively identified and worked upon
* Properties operate smoothly and consistently
* Resident complaints and recurring escalations reduce
* Resident satisfaction and retention remain strong
* Property teams have clear ownership and accountability
* Business and operational gaps are identified and corrected quickly
* The cluster performs without requiring constant intervention from senior leadership

The cluster operates through:

**Sales Hustle + Operational Discipline + Customer Ownership + Strong Execution**

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You enjoy Sales and get energy from converting opportunities
* You want your performance to directly influence what you earn
* You are comfortable being accountable for clear monthly targets
* You take ownership rather than waiting for someone to tell you what to do
* You enjoy being on the ground and interacting with customers
* You can manage both people and problems
* You are comfortable moving between multiple properties
* You can balance selling with running strong Operations
* You remain persistent when targets are difficult
* You want responsibility early in your career

**Experience we value**

We are open to
**high-potential freshers as well as candidates with 6 months – 1 year of Sales experience.**

Relevant exposure can include:

* Inside Sales
* Field Sales
* Business Development
* Real Estate / Property Sales
* Hospitality Sales
* Customer Acquisition
* Retail / High-Interaction Sales

For freshers, we will look strongly at:

* Sales orientation
* Communication and confidence
* Energy and hustle
* Comfort with targets
* Ownership mindset
* Ability to influence and convince people
* Willingness to work on ground and move across properties

**We are looking for someone who wants to sell, own outcomes, lead people, and eventually run a business — not someone looking only for an Operations role.**

**Compensation & Performance**

This is a strongly performance-linked role.

**Total Compensation: ₹6.65 LPA**

**₹3.65 LPA Fixed + ₹3 LPA Performance-Linked Variable**

The variable component will be linked to defined monthly performance outcomes.

This means strong performance has a
**direct and meaningful impact on your monthly earnings.**

**The impact you will have**

You will directly influence:

* Occupancy
* Sales & Revenue
* Lead Conversion
* Resident Experience
* Retention
* Property Operations
* Team Performance
* Cluster Business Performance

You won't own one small part of the customer journey.

**You will own what happens from prospect → booking → move-in → resident experience → retention across your cluster.**

**Why join now**

For someone early in their career, most roles ask you to execute one part of a business.

This role gives you the opportunity to
**own one.**
